titre: Les nouveaux cas de cancer aux Etats-Unis progressent chaque année
sous_titre: Nouveaux cas de cancer projetés aux Etats-Unis, en millions

2022.texte: In 2022, 1,918,030 new cancer cases and 609,360 cancer deaths are projected to occur in the United States.

2023.texte: In 2023, 1,958,310 new cancer cases and 609,820 cancer deaths are projected to occur in the United States.

2024.texte: In 2024, 2,001,140 new cancer cases and 611,720 cancer deaths are projected to occur in the United States.

2025.texte: In 2025, 2,041,910 new cancer cases and 618,120 cancer deaths are projected to occur in the United States.
